articles.summary: BP (LSE:BP.) is in talks to sell a stake in the offshore Bumerangue oil block in Brazil to Petrobras. The discussions focus on Petrobras taking a partner role in the Bumerangue field, which lies in Brazilian deepwater acreage. The negotiations could reshape BP's portfolio exposure in Brazil if a Bumerangue stake sale to Petrobras goes ahead.
